name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: name
label: Name
help: The person's name, up to 120 characters

name: company_url
label: Company URL
help: The company's website (http or https). It groups people into companies

name: social_url
label: Social URL
help: A link to their profile (http or https)

name: email
label: Email
help: Their email address. Never shown publicly. One person per address on a site
